text: Village governance committee meetings held monthly to discuss community affairs and administrative issues
Youth group organizes cultural events and community gathering for social bonding
Community members participate in mutual assistance for house repairs and construction projects
Women's cooperative group conducts skills training and educational workshops for community development
Neighborhood watch program established to ensure community safety and security
Rice farmers earn average income of 2-3 million IDR per harvest season
Coconut plantation generates revenue through copra and coconut oil production
Tourism business provides employment opportunity with average wage 1.5 million IDR per month
Coffee plantation produces 500 kg per year with market value around 4 million IDR
Cattle farming supports livelihoods with income from milk sales and breeding
Main road requires maintenance and repair every monsoon season
Water supply system serves 95 percent of households with daily distribution
Electricity network coverage reaches all villages with 24-hour service availability
Irrigation canals distribute water from main source to agricultural fields
Bridge construction project connects remote villages to main transportation network
Health clinic operates with staff of 3 nurses and 1 midwife providing basic healthcare
Vaccination program achieves 90 percent coverage among children under five years
Maternal health initiative reduces pregnancy complications through prenatal care
Sanitation awareness campaign improves hygiene practices and reduces waterborne diseases
Health workers conduct regular medical checkups and disease surveillance activities
Traditional dance performance Legong is performed during village ceremonies and festivals
Balinese temple celebrates annual festival with religious ceremonies and cultural programs
Local artisans produce traditional handicrafts including wood carving and weaving
Traditional music ensemble performs gamelan during wedding ceremonies and celebrations
Cultural heritage preservation project documents traditional knowledge and practices for younger generation
